=== The binomial that a REUSED top variable would produce (not the Lean's structure; control) ===
If lift j multiplied the same variable by z^a, the composite would carry (m a)! while the step bounds carry m*ph(a):
a | m | log((m a)!) - m*ph(a) | m*a*log m | (for comparison: one-lift allowance 2 w La, w = a/50)
